objective: Preallocate column-scan data prefixes from table-name length.

tasks.title: Preallocate column-scan data prefixes
tasks.result: Column-scan fast paths now use an explicit-capacity helper instead of format! for data:<table>: prefixes.

notes: Cargo verification used an E: workspace temp directory and CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 to avoid recurring MSVC PDB pressure.
The helper reserves capacity for data:<table>: before pushing known components.
The optimization replaces format! in bare aggregate, COUNT DISTINCT, SELECT DISTINCT, GROUP BY COUNT, multi-column grouped aggregate, and single-column grouped aggregate scans.
Generated prefix bytes, transaction scan prefixes, predicate filtering, aggregate state updates, distinct tracking, grouping, and SQL results are unchanged.
Focused sql_select tests were launched in parallel and printed Cargo file-lock wait messages before passing.
